_comment: Example policy with made-up projects. Copy to approval_policy.json and edit. Preview with: python3 policy.py run. Apply with: python3 policy.py run --apply. Bump version on every change. Projects match ignoring case, spaces and punctuation. Anything no rule covers goes to review, never to approved. Keys starting with _ are comments.

rules._note: Your own projects. Health flags are allowed because the product is about health; the never_auto_approve_flags above still block.
AI recommendations you never confirmed stay private.
